explanation: For each house choose between skipping it and adding its value to the best total that excludes its neighbor. Retain only the previous two totals.
timeComplexity: O(n) time for n houses. One transition is evaluated per house.
spaceComplexity: O(1) auxiliary space. Only the optimal totals for the preceding two prefixes are retained.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 Python algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
correctness: For each prefix, an optimal selection either skips the final house and keeps the preceding optimum, or takes it and adds its value to the optimum excluding its neighbor. These choices are exhaustive and legal. Taking their maximum maintains the prefix optimum using only two earlier totals.
walkthrough: For [4,1,8,2,5], optimal prefix totals are 4,4,12,12,17. The last total takes houses with values 4,8 and 5, none adjacent. Return 17.
edgeCases: Skipping every house is allowed when no value improves the total.
A single house is handled by the same recurrence.
The input is a line; its first and last houses are not neighbors.
